mapper.select:
select a.id as archiveId, i.id as itemId, a.cadre_name as cadreName, a.id_number as idNumber, i.item_type as itemType, i.item_name as itemName, i.material_date as materialDate, i.material_page_count as materialPageCount from bus_cadre_archive a left join bus_cadre_archive_item i on a.id = i.archive_id where a.deleted = 0 and i.deleted = 0 and i.archive_id != 0 and i.item_type not in ('originalImage', 'optimizeImage')
and a.cadre_name like concat('%', #{req.cadreName}, '%') or a.cadre_name_py like concat(#{req.cadreName}, '%')
and i.item_type in
#{itemType}
and i.item_name like concat('%', #{req.itemName}, '%')
order by a.id, i.parent_id, i.sort
